literalGroups.primaryGround: The named UH OER Publishing Guide table in “Outlining, Compiling & Writing” assigns Title page and Copyright page to Publisher. It states that the copyright page may carry ISBN, publication date/history and printing information. The prompt names the source and applies the row to a routine textbook-layout assignment.

literalParts.primaryGround: The guide assigns both Title page and Copyright page to Publisher. It lists title/subtitle, author/editor and illustrator on the title page; the copyright page may include publisher identity, ISBN, publication date/history and printing information. The applied task is assigning production responsibility for those pages.
literalParts.locator: UH OER Publishing Guide, complete front-matter table: Title page, Copyright page, Dedication, Foreword, Preface and Acknowledgements rows.

literalParts.primaryGround: The guide assigns Dedication, Preface, Acknowledgements and Introduction to Author; this is a different responsibility from producing the title/copyright pages.
literalParts.locator: UH OER Publishing Guide, complete front-matter table: Title page, Copyright page, Dedication, Foreword, Preface and Acknowledgements rows.

literalParts.primaryGround: The title-page row may list an editor alongside the author; the guide still assigns responsibility for preparing the page to Publisher.
literalParts.locator: UH OER Publishing Guide, complete front-matter table: Title page, Copyright page, Dedication, Foreword, Preface and Acknowledgements rows.

literalParts.primaryGround: The Title page row says the illustrator, if any, is named along with author/editor; naming a contributor does not make that contributor the party assigned to produce the title page.

absoluteDifficulty.ground: This asks the reader to apply routine OER book-production responsibilities to a concrete layout task. It relies on familiarity with who prepares front matter, not on an arbitrary technical threshold or obscure count.

limitations: UH guide notes that front/back matter tables are partly adapted from Wikipedia Book design. This packet attributes the practical guidance to the UH OER guide as published and makes no claim of independent scholarship for every convention.
